newsitem.title: INDIA: India moves bill to set up insurance regulator.
newsitem.headline: India moves bill to set up insurance regulator.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P.Chidambaram introduced in the lower house of parliament, Lok Sabha, on Thursday a bill which if passed would enable the setting up of an insurance industry regulator.
India, which has begun cautious attempts to ease a decades-old state monpoly in the insurance sector, says the regulator is the first step towards a planned entry of private firms in the field.
"The time has come to further strengthen the insurance sector as it now operates in several other countries," Chidambaram told the house while introducing the Insurance Regulatory Authority Bill.
The proposed authority would have a chairperson, not more than three whole-time members and a maximum of four part-time members, he said.
